subject.title: fix: stop exposing internal product data on public surfaces

question: What should the permanent public product contract be for ecommerce, Supply featured products, autocomplete, and prescriptor results?
rationale: The remaining blockers require deciding which fields are deliberately public per surface, not only adding more names to a denylist; `priceBuy` is sensitive on ecommerce product pages but appears intentionally public for Supply.

options.title: Unify around allowlists
options.body: Use a shared fail-closed public serializer for ecommerce product payloads and add narrowly named Supply/search/prescriptor variants for deliberately public fields.

options.title: Keep surface denylists
options.body: Allow separate denylists per endpoint, but require exact alignment, documentation, and regression tests for every public payload surface.

options.title: Pause for security sign-off
options.body: Hold the branch until ecommerce/API owners approve the public/private field boundary and stock-limit replacement behavior.

recommendation.title: Unify around allowlists
recommendation.body: Use a shared fail-closed public serializer for ecommerce product payloads and add narrowly named Supply/search/prescriptor variants for deliberately public fields.

likelyOwner.reason: alexcanHamelyn already identified the active security and compatibility blockers and is assigned for review on this PR.
